200.description: Offers for the feasible tiers and constraints for the others.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value "true", only when the response is the stored answer replayed for the same Idempotency-Key, method, path and body. The first execution never carries it.

window.description: The delivery window as two instants (RFC 3339 UTC) and the local calendar they belong to. A delivery date is a day of the destination's calendar: convert earliest and latest into timeZone before taking their date (e.g. 2026-10-31T14:00:00Z..2026-11-01T02:00:00Z in America/Chicago is the single day 2026-10-31).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination. Always set on a new offer; omitted only for an offer stored before it was carried (ADR 0011), in which case read the window in UTC.

window.title: DeliveryWindow

witnessPath.description: The node, pickup departure, departure legs and delivery wave that prove feasibility. A NOMINAL path (STANDARD only) carries no departure or wave ids: pickupDepartureId and deliveryWaveId are omitted and legs is empty (E8).
witnessPath.title: WitnessPath

expiresAt.description: min(quotedAt + offerTtl, the latest instant the witness pickup cutoff can still be met).

groupNo.description: Quote-relative shipment group number (1 for a single-node cart).

basis.description: Promise basis; NOMINAL only for STANDARD.
basis.title: Basis

policyVersion.description: The promise policy version the quote used (G8).

offers.description: One offer per (group, tier) with a feasible path, ordered by groupNo then tier.

constraint.description: Why a tier has no offer. PAST_ORDER_DEADLINE: the tier's order deadline in the destination region has passed (G19).
constraint.title: OfferConstraint

groupNo.description: The quote-relative shipment group the constraint applies to; omitted when it applies to the whole quote (DESTINATION_NOT_SERVED, ITEM_QUANTITY_NOT_AVAILABLE).

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or malformed (idempotency-key-invalid), the request body is malformed, or a collection GET sent an undeclared query parameter (unknown-query-parameter), a bad limit (invalid-limit) or an undecodable cursor (invalid-cursor).

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

409.description: State, capacity, closed or concurrency conflict (illegal-transition, concurrent-update, offer-not-quotable, promise-capacity-exhausted, book-closed, promise-hold-expired, promise-closed, revision-moves-earlier), or idempotency-key-reused when the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
